messages:
Alex: starting a joint benchmark with AuroraCore next week. focus: HBM power capping effects and multi-instance scaling for our marketplace SKU. want clear guidance on recommended power cap + instance layout for best perf/W.
Priya: thanks. do we care more about absolute throughput or energy per token? also, will this feed the marketplace performance card?
Alex: primary deliverable = perf/W curve and a recommended configuration table for small/medium/large customers. marketplace card + short partner quote.
Sam: proposed sweep: models = 7B, 13B; instances per GPU = 1,2; seq = 512/1024; power_cap = 200W/250W/300W; quant = fp16/int8. measure p50/p95, tokens/s, and joules/token.
Miguel: note on Aurora boxes: they have HBM thermal throttling reported at sustained 310W. they asked we test a 3-node scale as well. also track PCIe NVLink utilization.
Dana: I'll prep prometheus exporters and a dashboard. need ssh + prometheus scrape endpoints from Aurora. if exporters not allowed, we'll attach our external meter and push metrics.
Tess: marketing: keep the external messaging simple — two visuals: efficiency vs instances (perf/W) and scaling curve (tokens/sec vs instances). need co-branding approval and embargo window.
Jordan: runtime: I'm going to try an L2 prefetch hint toggle in our kernel path that might help multi-instance occupancy. small patch; could improve tokens/s for instance=2. will provide build artifact.
Priya: can we include a cold-start vs warmed-KV comparison? some customers care about small chat windows where cache warmup matters.
Alex: good call. include cold start (empty KV) and warmed (seed with 128 tokens).
Sam: repro harness command for Aurora lab (example):
```bash
python infra/bench/harness.py --model redwood-7b --instances 2 --seq 1024 --power-cap 250 --quant fp16 --profile prometheus --out aurora-run.json
```
Miguel: I'll coordinate logistics with Aurora infra. they can give 4 boxes Tue-Thu. request we reserve one extra for failure testing.
Dana: I'll create a perf template CSV we can drop into results analysis; columns = ts, model, instances, seq, batch, power_cap_w, avg_power_w, tokens_sec, p50_ms, p95_ms, joules_per_token, notes.
Jordan: patch branch: jordan/hbm-prefetch-toggle — will post artifact and Docker image tag. please smoke test with our staging machine before pushing to partner.
bench-bot: action created: partnerships/auroracore-hbm-sweep - assignees: Alex, Sam, Dana, Jordan - due: +9d
Tess: can everyone ack the Wed-Fri sweep window and confirm legal has the draft co-branding copy? cc: @legal
Alex: ack, I'll share the runbook + NDA stub with Aurora tonight.
Priya: ack
Sam: ack, will drop exporter container and validate power sensors
Miguel: ack, will handle Aurora scheduling
Dana: ack, will spin up dashboard and analysis notebook
Jordan: ack, will push patch and image Mon EOD
Alex: thanks — I'll consolidate artifacts (repro script, perf CSV template, dashboard link) and send to Aurora. we'll aim to produce a short marketplace blurb by next Tue after legal sign-off. :rocket:
